verses.text: Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

verses.text: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?

segments.text: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah,

verses.text: Blessed are they that keep justice, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.

segments.text: Blessed are they that keep justice,

verses.text: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the favor that thou bearest unto thy people; Oh visit me with thy salvation,

Oh visit me with thy salvation,

verses.text: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.

verses.text: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

verses.text: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy lovingkindnesses, But were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

verses.text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.

verses.text: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.

verses.text: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.text: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.

verses.text: Then believed they his words; They sang his praise.

verses.text: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.

verses.text: And he gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.

verses.text: They envied Moses also in the camp, And Aaron the saint of Jehovah.

verses.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.

verses.text: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.

verses.text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

verses.text: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.

verses.text: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye Jehovah.
